children.text: Some countries' passports allow their holders to visit many countries, while citizens of other countries face certain restrictions. Fortunately, there are visas that open the borders of various countries and make travel possible, even in cases where a separate visa was previously required for each trip.
In today's blog, we'll share the countries where a single visa can get you into many others.
Countries You Can Travel to With a Schengen Visa
A Schengen visa is issued by one of the Schengen member countries and allows the holder to travel to any Schengen member country for 90 days within any 180-day period.
